name: Yami no Koe III ~Gobou San'yoku Mahoujin~
original_name: 闇の声III ～五芒三欲魔方陣～
source: K is trapped within the academy, and recruits a passerby to find girls in various locations outside the academy in order to break the barrier. To accomplish this, she lends him her bag containing clothing and apparel with a degenerating influence.
